quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive faster than other cars.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Slow down.
Drive very close behind the car in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: When rain makes it hard to see, slow down. Turn on your headlights so other drivers can see you. If rain is so heavy you cannot see well, pull to the side of the road and stop until it clears.

questions.question: How can you help prevent road rage and aggressive driving?

options.text: Allow extra time for your trip.
Follow posted speed limits.
Use your turn signals correctly.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: More drivers on the road means more road rage. To prevent it, use your turn signals, follow speed limits, and give yourself plenty of time to get where you are going.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights?

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Keep driving in your lane.
Pull to the right side and stop.
Stop right where you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right side and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear its siren, pull over to the right side of the road right away and stop.

questions.question: You should not enter an intersection if you will block it when the light turns red. When does this rule apply?

options.text: At all times.
Only if you entered on a yellow light.
Only if you entered on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times.
questions.explanation: Even if the light is green, do not enter an intersection unless you can cross it completely before the light turns red. Blocking the intersection can result in a ticket.

questions.question: A yellow light warns that the red light is coming. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, what should you do?

options.text: Stop.
Keep going and clear the intersection safely.
Speed up to avoid causing an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep going and clear the intersection safely.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, move through it as quickly as you safely can.

questions.question: What does a red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop at the stop line.
Stop before entering any crosswalk.
Stop before entering the intersection.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop. Stop at the stop line, before any crosswalk, and before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What technique helps drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as soon as possible.
Use four-wheel drive.
Slow down and leave more space between cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and leave more space between cars.
questions.explanation: On snow or ice, slow down and increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. These are the best ways to avoid crashes.

questions.question: When should you turn off your turn signal?

options.text: Before you start to turn
While you are turning
After you finish turning

questions.correctAnswerText: After you finish turning
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal before you start turning to warn other drivers. Turn it off after you finish the turn.

questions.question: What do construction zone signs look like?

options.text: Square or rectangular with white and red colors.
Round or octagonal with black and yellow colors.
Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black colors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black colors.
questions.explanation: Construction zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols. They are placed on the right side of the road, or on both sides if the road is divided.

questions.question: What must you do when turning right on a green light?

options.text: Keep your normal driving speed.
Stop and look for police cars.
Let pedestrians go first.
Drive faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians go first.
questions.explanation: You can turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When turning, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: When driving through a construction zone, you should:

options.text: Stop to watch the workers.
Decrease your following distance.
Drive carefully through and do not slow down to look at the area.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through and do not slow down to look at the area.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down to look at the construction zone. This causes traffic to back up. Keep your attention on driving safely.

questions.question: At a flashing red light, you should:

options.text: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Stop only if other cars are approaching the intersection.
Stop only if other cars are already in the intersection.
Slow down and prepare to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let other drivers pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: A broken yellow line in the center of the road means:

options.text: A construction zone is ahead.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means any driver can pass when there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Where can you safely pass another vehicle?

options.text: In an intersection if there are no oncoming vehicles.
Wherever signs and markings allow passing.
On a curve if there are no oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wherever signs and markings allow passing.
questions.explanation: Never pass in intersections, parking lots, or alleys. Do not pass on curves or hills where you cannot see oncoming traffic. Only pass where signs and road markings allow it, and only if you have enough space to do so safely.

questions.question: Use your horn when:

options.text: Another vehicle is in your way.
It may help prevent a crash.
Another driver makes a mistake.

questions.correctAnswerText: It may help prevent a crash.
questions.explanation: Only use your horn when necessary to avoid a crash. Do not use it to make other drivers go faster or move out of your way.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to pedestrians:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road.
If the pedestrian signals you to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in the street, even if they are crossing against the light or not paying attention.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for bicycles.
Bicycles are not allowed.
Bicycle repair shop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles, animals, and pedestrians that may cross the road.

questions.question: What helps drivers save gasoline?

options.text: Letting the car run while parked.
Speeding up quickly.
Slowing down gradually.
Braking hard suddenly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down gradually.
questions.explanation: Every sudden stop wastes fuel when you speed up again. Look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes to avoid hard braking. This saves gas and fuel.

questions.question: The correct way to make a right turn is to:

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move into the lane closest to the center line before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach in the right lane, but move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Signal your turn to warn other drivers. Slow down and stay in the right lane as close to the right curb as possible before you turn.

questions.question: A sign with a red circle and a slash through it means:

options.text: Come to a complete stop.
An action is forbidden.
Some drivers must yield to others.
Drive under the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: An action is forbidden.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash is a prohibition sign. It means you cannot do the action shown under the circle. These signs are white with red and black markings.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your:

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.
Hazard flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. Use fog lights if you have them. High beams bounce off fog and reflect back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When you drive through an area where children are playing, you should expect them:

options.text: To know when it is safe to cross the street.
To stop at the curb before crossing the street.
To run out in front of you without looking.
Not to cross the street unless they are with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: To run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful around children. They may not understand danger and could run in front of your car without looking.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely to be:

options.text: A deaf person.
A person involved with a traffic study.
A blind person.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: A blind person.
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the person is blind. Always give the right-of-way to blind pedestrians using these tools.

questions.question: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options.text: Using your high beam lights in the fog.
Staring at the road ahead of your vehicle.
Checking your rearview mirrors frequently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Checking your rearview mirrors frequently.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors every 2 to 5 seconds to stay aware of hazards. Staring only at the road ahead is dangerous. Do not use high beams in fog.

questions.question: When entering the interstate, check for a gap in traffic in the nearest lane, adjust your speed to match traffic, signal, and:

options.text: Expect traffic to allow you to proceed into the lane, since you have the right-of-way.
Merge carefully into the gap.
Wait for the lane to clear before merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge carefully into the gap.
questions.explanation: Find a gap, match the traffic speed, signal, and then merge carefully into the gap. Do not expect other drivers to make room for you. Stay alert and do not rely on other drivers to clear the lane.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Challenge them.
Get out of their way.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of their way.
questions.explanation: The safest thing to do with an aggressive driver is to get out of their way. Never compete with other drivers or try to challenge them.

questions.question: You may park or stop along the shoulder of the freeway:

options.text: As long as you turn on your four-way (emergency) flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to look at a map for directions.
Only if you have an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if you have an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except in an emergency.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: May be safely held by a strong adult.
Will be safe if they are standing on the floor in the back of the vehicle.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Children must always be properly secured in a seat. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during a crash or sudden stop. Use special child seats for small children.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive faster than the flow of traffic.
Drive slower than the flow of traffic.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other traffic. Drive with the flow of traffic while staying within the speed limit.
